caption: The drawing depicts a woman standing in profile view, facing left. She is dressed in a voluminous, floor-length light blue gown with a full skirt. The dress is adorned with an elaborate black lace trim along the hem, the lower edge of the skirt, and the wide off-the-shoulder capelet or shawl draped around her upper torso. This capelet has additional blue floral decorations along the top edge. The woman’s sleeves are short, and she wears blue bows at the elbows. Her hands are in front of her, with one hand holding a fan or folded accessory. She has light-colored hair styled smoothly back and covered with a beige or light gold bonnet that ties under the chin and is embellished with a blue bow. Her facial skin is pale, with faintly rosy cheeks and lips, and she wears a single-strand gold necklace. The background is plain and beige, with no additional objects or decorations visible. The artist's name, "Eugène Croe," is written in the lower right corner.
title: Doll - "Antoinette"
